question.text:
Leo Capricorn's new film is likely to be a huge box-office success. The film is called 'Overkill' (NP). It is going to be
released next week (PC).

Leo Capricorn's [new film, 'Overkill', released next week|new film, 'Overkill', being released next week|new film, 'Overkill', to be released next week] is likely to be a huge box-office success.
question.modelAnswerString: Leo Capricorn's new film, 'Overkill', released next week / new film, 'Overkill', being released next week / new film, 'Overkill', to be released next week is likely to be a huge box-office success.

question.text:

question.text:

question.text:

yesterday's meeting (PC).

question.text:

in the fire (PC).

question.modelAnswerString: The paintings by Ella Lutman destroyed in the fire were probably worth over a million dollars.

question.text:
The pay increase was described as 'Ridiculous' by Tony Sharples. The pay increase was demanded by train drivers (PC).
Tony Sharples is managing director of National Rail (NP).

The pay increase [demanded by train drivers] was described as 'Ridiculous' by Tony Sharples, [managing director of National Rail].
question.modelAnswerString: The pay increase demanded by train drivers was described as 'Ridiculous' by Tony Sharples, managing director of National Rail.
